_comment: Messages Morphly shows its users. Fetched at runtime, so a notice reaches copies that are already installed without a release. Only builds from 0.6 onwards read this file: a notice cannot reach an older one, which is why the list starts empty rather than carrying a warning for 0.5.1 that would never be delivered. Keep it short and remove a notice once it has done its work, because every entry interrupts somebody. Fields: id, level (info|important), title, body, url (https only), linkText, platforms (linux|win32|darwin), minVersion, maxVersion, published. maxVersion reaches only the people still running an affected build. See app/src/main/notices.js.
